- `diffusion_samples` (number, optional; bounds 1..5): Diffusion samples

```json
{
  "inputs": [

          "msa": {
            "main": {

              }
            }
          },
          "sequence": "{{sequence}}",
          "type": "protein"
        }
      ],
      "output_format": "{{output_format}}"
    }
  ],
  "request_id": "forge-openfold3"
}
```
